A film director is one of the most pivotal members of any movie production. They are what gives the film its look and feel as the director attempts to bring together the best possible cast and crew to deliver a movie that captivates audiences, shapes culture and brings people to the theaters in droves.
There are some names in the movie business that are tapped to do it again and again. The Steven Spielbergs, James Camerons and Christopher Nolans are the names that Hollywood turns to, who have become almost as A-list as the actors on the screen and have been driving decades of box office success.
These are Hollywood’s best directors of all time, ranked by global box office gross.
> **Discover why these directors became Hollywood legends. Watch some of their biggest box office hits with DIRECTV.**
* * *

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
Here’s an overview of the top grossing film directors:

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **1. Steven Spielberg ($10.72 billion)**
Even if money had nothing to do with it, Steven Spielberg is one of the most influential figures in modern Hollywood. He mastered the art of the summer blockbuster with _Jaws_ in 1975, which made him a household name. _Close Encounters of the Third Kind_, _E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial_ and the _Indiana Jones_ series followed one right after another.
Spielberg delivered one of the most iconic science fiction hits in _Jurassic Park_, which became the highest-grossing film ever at the time and drove record ticket sales worldwide. He followed that up with _Schindler’s List_, which won him the Academy Award for best director. He won it again for _Saving Private Ryan_ just a few years later.
Across more than 100 feature films, Spielberg often alternates between epic sci-fi stories like _A.I. Artificial Intelligence_, _Minority Report_, _War of the Worlds_ and _Ready Player One_ with ambitious historical dramas rich in story, be it _Amistad_, _War Horse_, _Lincoln_ or _The Post_. He’s had comedies like _Catch Me If You Can_. He’s dipped into animation with _The Adventures of Tintin_ and even the musical world with _West Side Story_.
His career is so fascinating it spawned a semi-autobiographical film in _The Fabelmans_ in 2022.
**Steven Spielberg’s highest-grossing film:**_Jurassic Park_ at $1.1 billion worldwide.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **2. James Cameron ($9.8 billion)**
Cameron made his mark on Hollywood in the mid-1980s with _The Terminator_, followed by _Aliens_, _Terminator 2_ and _True Lies_. Cameron often tells the stories of humanity versus nature and technology.
Cameron’s true breakthrough came with _Titanic_, which in 1999 became the highest-grossing film of all time and won him an Academy Award.
But it is the _Avatar_ movies that have elevated him to a new level of ambitious filmmaking. Cameron has three of the top four highest-grossing films of all time. _Avatar_ is number one, _Avatar: The Way of Water_ is number three and _Titanic_ is number four.
**James Cameron’s highest-grossing film: _Avatar_**at $2.9 billion worldwide.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **3. Russo Brothers ($6.76 billion)**
The Russo Brothers were the tandem behind the epic Marvel Cinematic Universe. Their first foray came through _Captain America: The Winter Soldier_, before taking on three of the most influential films in the run with _Captain America: Civil War_, _Avengers: Infinity War_ and _Avengers: Endgame_. The latter two are two of the top six highest-grossing films of all time.
The Russo Brothers are returning once again to the Marvel Cinematic Universe with _Avengers: Doomsday_, which drops Dec. 18, 2026.
The two started off in the sitcom world as the handpicked directors by Ron Howard of the _Arrested Development_ pilot and the NBC cult classic _Community_.
**The Russo Brothers’ highest-grossing film:**_Avengers: Endgame_ at $2.8 billion.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **4. Peter Jackson ($6.55 billion)**
Peter Jackson rose to global stardom by directing _The Lord of the Rings_ trilogy and then ultimately _The Hobbit_ trilogy.
_The Lord of the Rings_ became a worldwide sensation, and _The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King_ set a record for Academy Awards won, including three by Jackson himself for best picture, best director and best adapted screenplay.
Jackson also went on to direct the Beatles documentary _Get Back_ and is slated to direct the currently untitled _Adventures of Tintin_ sequel.
**Peter Jackson’s highest-grossing film:**_The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King_ at $1.12 billion.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **5. Michael Bay ($6.5 billion)**
If there’s one word to describe Michael Bay as a filmmaker, it’s explosive. The Los Angeles native has moviemaking in his bones and is behind the camera of some of the most entertaining action movies of the mid-1990s and early 2000s.
With fast cuts and no shortage of special effects, Bay has directed _Bad Boys_, _Bad Boys II_, _Armageddon_, _Pearl Harbor_, _Pain & Gain_ and as of 2022, _Ambulance_.
But one universe he stayed in more than any other is _Transformers_. He’s directed five of the _Transformers_ films since its release in 2007.
**Michael Bay’s highest-grossing film:**_Transformers: Dark of the Moon_ at $1.1 billion.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **6. David Yates ($6.35 billion)**
David Yates is responsible for one of the biggest franchises in the early 21st century, that of _Harry Potter_. Yates took over for the final four films, including the two highest-grossing in _Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows_, parts one and two.
He then went on to direct all three _Fantastic Beasts_ movies and most recently the black comedy _Pain Hustlers_.
Yates’s next project is _Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them 4_, which is currently in development.
**David Yates’s highest-grossing film:**_Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2_ at $1.1 billion.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **7. Christopher Nolan ($6.35 billion)**
Chrispher Nolan is perhaps the most influential director of the 21st century. He burst onto the scene with _The Dark Knight_ trilogy, _The Prestige_ and _Inception_ within seven years, and has since followed up with high-concept sci-fi films like _Interstellar_and _Tenet_ and ambitious historical dramas in _Dunkirk_ and _Oppenheimer_.
But all of that previous ambition pales in comparison to his greatest epic yet, _The Odyssey_, the retelling of Homer’s epic, released in theaters July 17, 2026. Nolan’s adaptation delivered the biggest opening of his career, earning $264.1 million worldwide in its debut weekend.
**Christopher Nolan’s highest-grossing film:**_The Dark Knight Rises_, which earned more than $1 billion at the box office.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **8. Ridley Scott ($5.04 billion)**
Ridley Scott has been making blockbusters since he burst onto the scene with _Alien_ in 1979 and _Blade Runner_ just a few years later.
After a brief foray into the commercial world, Scott came back to the big screen with _Gladiator_, which won an Academy Award, followed by _Hannibal_, _Black Hawk Down_ and _American Gangster_.
Scott continued with _The Martian_, _Alien: Covenant_ and most recently, back into the world of _Gladiator_ with _Gladiator II_.
Scott shows no signs of slowing down, with more than six projects currently in development.
**Ridley Scott’s highest-grossing film:**_The Martian_ at $630 million worldwide.

# James Cameron has now directed three of the top 10 highest-grossing films of all time
By C Mandler
January 9, 2023 / 5:29 PM EST / CBS News
Add CBS News on Google
Director James Cameron's newest film, "Avatar: The Way of Water," is now the seventh highest-grossing film ever — raking in $1.7 billion at the global box office — and the third of Cameron's films among the top 10 highest-grossing movies of all time, according to IMDb. All three films were released in different decades.
A screen displays Avatar: The Way of Water poster in a cinema at Times Square on Jan. 5, 2023, in New York City. Photo by Leonardo Munoz/VIEWpress via Getty Images
The other two of Cameron's films to break the top 10 are the No. 3 "Titanic," for which he won the best director Oscar in 1998, and 2009's original "Avatar," which is the highest-grossing movie of all time at $2.9 billion.
"Avatar 2" had a robust opening weekend during its December release, bringing in $134 million in its domestic debut. It is the highest-grossing film of 2022, beating "Top Gun: Maverick," which previously held the spot.
Cameron has said there will be three more Avatar sequels set to arrive every two years, with release dates in 2024, 2026 and 2028.

# James Cameron has now directed three of the top 10 highest-grossing films of all time
By C Mandler
January 9, 2023 / 5:29 PM EST / CBS News
Add CBS News on Google
Director James Cameron's newest film, "Avatar: The Way of Water," is now the seventh highest-grossing film ever — raking in $1.7 billion at the global box office — and the third of Cameron's films among the top 10 highest-grossing movies of all time, according to IMDb. All three films were released in different decades.
A screen displays Avatar: The Way of Water poster in a cinema at Times Square on Jan. 5, 2023, in New York City. Photo by Leonardo Munoz/VIEWpress via Getty Images
The other two of Cameron's films to break the top 10 are the No. 3 "Titanic," for which he won the best director Oscar in 1998, and 2009's original "Avatar," which is the highest-grossing movie of all time at $2.9 billion.
"Avatar 2" had a robust opening weekend during its December release, bringing in $134 million in its domestic debut. It is the highest-grossing film of 2022, beating "Top Gun: Maverick," which previously held the spot.
Cameron has said there will be three more Avatar sequels set to arrive every two years, with release dates in 2024, 2026 and 2028.

A film director is one of the most pivotal members of any movie production. They are what gives the film its look and feel as the director attempts to bring together the best possible cast and crew to deliver a movie that captivates audiences, shapes culture and brings people to the theaters in droves.
There are some names in the movie business that are tapped to do it again and again. The Steven Spielbergs, James Camerons and Christopher Nolans are the names that Hollywood turns to, who have become almost as A-list as the actors on the screen and have been driving decades of box office success.
These are Hollywood’s best directors of all time, ranked by global box office gross.
> **Discover why these directors became Hollywood legends. Watch some of their biggest box office hits with DIRECTV.**
* * *
texts.1:
## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
Here’s an overview of the top grossing film directors:
texts.2:
## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **1. Steven Spielberg ($10.72 billion)**
Even if money had nothing to do with it, Steven Spielberg is one of the most influential figures in modern Hollywood. He mastered the art of the summer blockbuster with _Jaws_ in 1975, which made him a household name. _Close Encounters of the Third Kind_, _E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial_ and the _Indiana Jones_ series followed one right after another.
Spielberg delivered one of the most iconic science fiction hits in _Jurassic Park_, which became the highest-grossing film ever at the time and drove record ticket sales worldwide. He followed that up with _Schindler’s List_, which won him the Academy Award for best director. He won it again for _Saving Private Ryan_ just a few years later.
Across more than 100 feature films, Spielberg often alternates between epic sci-fi stories like _A.I. Artificial Intelligence_, _Minority Report_, _War of the Worlds_ and _Ready Player One_ with ambitious historical dramas rich in story, be it _Amistad_, _War Horse_, _Lincoln_ or _The Post_. He’s had comedies like _Catch Me If You Can_. He’s dipped into animation with _The Adventures of Tintin_ and even the musical world with _West Side Story_.
His career is so fascinating it spawned a semi-autobiographical film in _The Fabelmans_ in 2022.
**Steven Spielberg’s highest-grossing film:**_Jurassic Park_ at $1.1 billion worldwide.
texts.3:
## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **2. James Cameron ($9.8 billion)**
Cameron made his mark on Hollywood in the mid-1980s with _The Terminator_, followed by _Aliens_, _Terminator 2_ and _True Lies_. Cameron often tells the stories of humanity versus nature and technology.
Cameron’s true breakthrough came with _Titanic_, which in 1999 became the highest-grossing film of all time and won him an Academy Award.
But it is the _Avatar_ movies that have elevated him to a new level of ambitious filmmaking. Cameron has three of the top four highest-grossing films of all time. _Avatar_ is number one, _Avatar: The Way of Water_ is number three and _Titanic_ is number four.
**James Cameron’s highest-grossing film: _Avatar_**at $2.9 billion worldwide.
texts.4:
## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **3. Russo Brothers ($6.76 billion)**
The Russo Brothers were the tandem behind the epic Marvel Cinematic Universe. Their first foray came through _Captain America: The Winter Soldier_, before taking on three of the most influential films in the run with _Captain America: Civil War_, _Avengers: Infinity War_ and _Avengers: Endgame_. The latter two are two of the top six highest-grossing films of all time.
The Russo Brothers are returning once again to the Marvel Cinematic Universe with _Avengers: Doomsday_, which drops Dec. 18, 2026.
The two started off in the sitcom world as the handpicked directors by Ron Howard of the _Arrested Development_ pilot and the NBC cult classic _Community_.
**The Russo Brothers’ highest-grossing film:**_Avengers: Endgame_ at $2.8 billion.
texts.5:
## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **4. Peter Jackson ($6.55 billion)**
Peter Jackson rose to global stardom by directing _The Lord of the Rings_ trilogy and then ultimately _The Hobbit_ trilogy.
_The Lord of the Rings_ became a worldwide sensation, and _The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King_ set a record for Academy Awards won, including three by Jackson himself for best picture, best director and best adapted screenplay.
Jackson also went on to direct the Beatles documentary _Get Back_ and is slated to direct the currently untitled _Adventures of Tintin_ sequel.
**Peter Jackson’s highest-grossing film:**_The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King_ at $1.12 billion.
texts.6:
## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **5. Michael Bay ($6.5 billion)**
If there’s one word to describe Michael Bay as a filmmaker, it’s explosive. The Los Angeles native has moviemaking in his bones and is behind the camera of some of the most entertaining action movies of the mid-1990s and early 2000s.
With fast cuts and no shortage of special effects, Bay has directed _Bad Boys_, _Bad Boys II_, _Armageddon_, _Pearl Harbor_, _Pain & Gain_ and as of 2022, _Ambulance_.
But one universe he stayed in more than any other is _Transformers_. He’s directed five of the _Transformers_ films since its release in 2007.
**Michael Bay’s highest-grossing film:**_Transformers: Dark of the Moon_ at $1.1 billion.
texts.7:
## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **6. David Yates ($6.35 billion)**
David Yates is responsible for one of the biggest franchises in the early 21st century, that of _Harry Potter_. Yates took over for the final four films, including the two highest-grossing in _Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows_, parts one and two.
He then went on to direct all three _Fantastic Beasts_ movies and most recently the black comedy _Pain Hustlers_.
Yates’s next project is _Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them 4_, which is currently in development.
**David Yates’s highest-grossing film:**_Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2_ at $1.1 billion.
texts.8:
## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **7. Christopher Nolan ($6.35 billion)**
Chrispher Nolan is perhaps the most influential director of the 21st century. He burst onto the scene with _The Dark Knight_ trilogy, _The Prestige_ and _Inception_ within seven years, and has since followed up with high-concept sci-fi films like _Interstellar_and _Tenet_ and ambitious historical dramas in _Dunkirk_ and _Oppenheimer_.
But all of that previous ambition pales in comparison to his greatest epic yet, _The Odyssey_, the retelling of Homer’s epic, released in theaters July 17, 2026. Nolan’s adaptation delivered the biggest opening of his career, earning $264.1 million worldwide in its debut weekend.
**Christopher Nolan’s highest-grossing film:**_The Dark Knight Rises_, which earned more than $1 billion at the box office.
texts.9:
## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **8. Ridley Scott ($5.04 billion)**
Ridley Scott has been making blockbusters since he burst onto the scene with _Alien_ in 1979 and _Blade Runner_ just a few years later.
After a brief foray into the commercial world, Scott came back to the big screen with _Gladiator_, which won an Academy Award, followed by _Hannibal_, _Black Hawk Down_ and _American Gangster_.
Scott continued with _The Martian_, _Alien: Covenant_ and most recently, back into the world of _Gladiator_ with _Gladiator II_.
Scott shows no signs of slowing down, with more than six projects currently in development.
**Ridley Scott’s highest-grossing film:**_The Martian_ at $630 million worldwide.

A film director is one of the most pivotal members of any movie production. They are what gives the film its look and feel as the director attempts to bring together the best possible cast and crew to deliver a movie that captivates audiences, shapes culture and brings people to the theaters in droves.
There are some names in the movie business that are tapped to do it again and again. The Steven Spielbergs, James Camerons and Christopher Nolans are the names that Hollywood turns to, who have become almost as A-list as the actors on the screen and have been driving decades of box office success.
These are Hollywood’s best directors of all time, ranked by global box office gross.
> **Discover why these directors became Hollywood legends. Watch some of their biggest box office hits with DIRECTV.**
* * *

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
Here’s an overview of the top grossing film directors:

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **1. Steven Spielberg ($10.72 billion)**
Even if money had nothing to do with it, Steven Spielberg is one of the most influential figures in modern Hollywood. He mastered the art of the summer blockbuster with _Jaws_ in 1975, which made him a household name. _Close Encounters of the Third Kind_, _E.T. The Extra-Terrestrial_ and the _Indiana Jones_ series followed one right after another.
Spielberg delivered one of the most iconic science fiction hits in _Jurassic Park_, which became the highest-grossing film ever at the time and drove record ticket sales worldwide. He followed that up with _Schindler’s List_, which won him the Academy Award for best director. He won it again for _Saving Private Ryan_ just a few years later.
Across more than 100 feature films, Spielberg often alternates between epic sci-fi stories like _A.I. Artificial Intelligence_, _Minority Report_, _War of the Worlds_ and _Ready Player One_ with ambitious historical dramas rich in story, be it _Amistad_, _War Horse_, _Lincoln_ or _The Post_. He’s had comedies like _Catch Me If You Can_. He’s dipped into animation with _The Adventures of Tintin_ and even the musical world with _West Side Story_.
His career is so fascinating it spawned a semi-autobiographical film in _The Fabelmans_ in 2022.
**Steven Spielberg’s highest-grossing film:**_Jurassic Park_ at $1.1 billion worldwide.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **2. James Cameron ($9.8 billion)**
Cameron made his mark on Hollywood in the mid-1980s with _The Terminator_, followed by _Aliens_, _Terminator 2_ and _True Lies_. Cameron often tells the stories of humanity versus nature and technology.
Cameron’s true breakthrough came with _Titanic_, which in 1999 became the highest-grossing film of all time and won him an Academy Award.
But it is the _Avatar_ movies that have elevated him to a new level of ambitious filmmaking. Cameron has three of the top four highest-grossing films of all time. _Avatar_ is number one, _Avatar: The Way of Water_ is number three and _Titanic_ is number four.
**James Cameron’s highest-grossing film: _Avatar_**at $2.9 billion worldwide.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **3. Russo Brothers ($6.76 billion)**
The Russo Brothers were the tandem behind the epic Marvel Cinematic Universe. Their first foray came through _Captain America: The Winter Soldier_, before taking on three of the most influential films in the run with _Captain America: Civil War_, _Avengers: Infinity War_ and _Avengers: Endgame_. The latter two are two of the top six highest-grossing films of all time.
The Russo Brothers are returning once again to the Marvel Cinematic Universe with _Avengers: Doomsday_, which drops Dec. 18, 2026.
The two started off in the sitcom world as the handpicked directors by Ron Howard of the _Arrested Development_ pilot and the NBC cult classic _Community_.
**The Russo Brothers’ highest-grossing film:**_Avengers: Endgame_ at $2.8 billion.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **4. Peter Jackson ($6.55 billion)**
Peter Jackson rose to global stardom by directing _The Lord of the Rings_ trilogy and then ultimately _The Hobbit_ trilogy.
_The Lord of the Rings_ became a worldwide sensation, and _The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King_ set a record for Academy Awards won, including three by Jackson himself for best picture, best director and best adapted screenplay.
Jackson also went on to direct the Beatles documentary _Get Back_ and is slated to direct the currently untitled _Adventures of Tintin_ sequel.
**Peter Jackson’s highest-grossing film:**_The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King_ at $1.12 billion.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **5. Michael Bay ($6.5 billion)**
If there’s one word to describe Michael Bay as a filmmaker, it’s explosive. The Los Angeles native has moviemaking in his bones and is behind the camera of some of the most entertaining action movies of the mid-1990s and early 2000s.
With fast cuts and no shortage of special effects, Bay has directed _Bad Boys_, _Bad Boys II_, _Armageddon_, _Pearl Harbor_, _Pain & Gain_ and as of 2022, _Ambulance_.
But one universe he stayed in more than any other is _Transformers_. He’s directed five of the _Transformers_ films since its release in 2007.
**Michael Bay’s highest-grossing film:**_Transformers: Dark of the Moon_ at $1.1 billion.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **6. David Yates ($6.35 billion)**
David Yates is responsible for one of the biggest franchises in the early 21st century, that of _Harry Potter_. Yates took over for the final four films, including the two highest-grossing in _Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows_, parts one and two.
He then went on to direct all three _Fantastic Beasts_ movies and most recently the black comedy _Pain Hustlers_.
Yates’s next project is _Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them 4_, which is currently in development.
**David Yates’s highest-grossing film:**_Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2_ at $1.1 billion.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **7. Christopher Nolan ($6.35 billion)**
Chrispher Nolan is perhaps the most influential director of the 21st century. He burst onto the scene with _The Dark Knight_ trilogy, _The Prestige_ and _Inception_ within seven years, and has since followed up with high-concept sci-fi films like _Interstellar_and _Tenet_ and ambitious historical dramas in _Dunkirk_ and _Oppenheimer_.
But all of that previous ambition pales in comparison to his greatest epic yet, _The Odyssey_, the retelling of Homer’s epic, released in theaters July 17, 2026. Nolan’s adaptation delivered the biggest opening of his career, earning $264.1 million worldwide in its debut weekend.
**Christopher Nolan’s highest-grossing film:**_The Dark Knight Rises_, which earned more than $1 billion at the box office.

## **Highest Grossing Film Directors of All-Time**
### **8. Ridley Scott ($5.04 billion)**
Ridley Scott has been making blockbusters since he burst onto the scene with _Alien_ in 1979 and _Blade Runner_ just a few years later.
After a brief foray into the commercial world, Scott came back to the big screen with _Gladiator_, which won an Academy Award, followed by _Hannibal_, _Black Hawk Down_ and _American Gangster_.
Scott continued with _The Martian_, _Alien: Covenant_ and most recently, back into the world of _Gladiator_ with _Gladiator II_.
Scott shows no signs of slowing down, with more than six projects currently in development.
**Ridley Scott’s highest-grossing film:**_The Martian_ at $630 million worldwide.
